papers.title: Integrated computational modeling of electromechanical coupling corrosion behavior in titanium alloys
papers.abstract: Abstract Titanium alloys are prone to failure under the coupling effect of machinery and environment, and the experimental research on stress corrosion is time-consuming and expensive. This study utilized a multi-physics field coupling model to reveal the electrochemical corrosion behavior of Ti80, TC4, and TA15 titanium alloys under tensile loading. The results indicated that the von Mises stress at the corrosion defect dominated the electrochemical heterogeneity, and the corrosion was quasi-uniform under low strain; when the tensile strain exceeded the critical threshold (Ti80: 0.4%, TC4: 0.6%, TA15: 0.425%), stress concentration triggered accelerated local anode dissolution, resulting in a negative shift in potential, and the corrosion entered a self-accelerating cycle. The Ford-Anderson model was used to quantify the crack propagation kinetics, and the prediction was consistent with the experimental results. This electromechanical coupling mechanism provides a new idea for predicting and preventing stress corrosion cracking in titanium alloys.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要研究钛合金的腐蚀行为，而非增材制造Ti-6Al-4V的力学或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: The paper focuses on corrosion behavior under tensile loading for generic titanium alloys (Ti80, TC4, TA15) without any additive manufacturing context, and does not address mechanical or fatigue performance of AM Ti-6Al-4V.

summary_zh.motivation: 钛合金在力学与环境耦合下易失效，实验耗时长成本高。
summary_zh.method: 建立多物理场耦合模型研究拉伸载荷下钛合金的电化学腐蚀行为。
summary_zh.result: 低应变下腐蚀准均匀，超过临界应变后应力集中加速局部阳极溶解。
summary_zh.validation: 使用Ford-Anderson模型预测裂纹扩展并与实验结果对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: Titanium alloys are prone to failure under mechanical-environmental coupling, and experimental stress corrosion studies are time-consuming and expensive.
summary_en.method: A multi-physics coupling model was developed to reveal electrochemical corrosion behavior of titanium alloys under tensile loading.
summary_en.result: Corrosion was quasi-uniform at low strain; beyond critical strain, stress concentration accelerated local anodic dissolution, leading to self-accelerating corrosion.
summary_en.validation: The Ford-Anderson model quantified crack propagation kinetics, and predictions agreed with experimental results.

papers.title: Effect of Build Orientation on Laser Welding Characteristics of SLM-Fabricated Ti-6Al-4V Components
papers.first_author_affiliation: Mechanical Engineering Faculty, University of Tabriz, Tabriz, Iran

corresponding_authors.name: Habib Hamed Zargari
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Advanced Materials Research Institute, Sahand University of Technology, Tabriz, Iran

papers.venue: Journal of Materials Engineering and Performance

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究SLM制造Ti-6Al-4V的激光焊接特性，而非基体力学或疲劳性能，因此与L1方向仅有间接关联。
llm.why_not_core: The paper studies laser welding characteristics, not the base mechanical or fatigue performance of as-built or process-state Ti-6Al-4V.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究构建方向对SLM制造Ti-6Al-4V激光焊接特性的影响
summary_zh.method: 采用不同构建方向的试样进行激光焊接实验
summary_zh.result: 构建方向显著影响焊接质量与微观组织
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试验证焊接接头性能

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of build orientation on the laser welding characteristics of SLM-fabricated Ti-6Al-4V components.
summary_en.method: Laser welding experiments were conducted on specimens with different build orientations.
summary_en.result: Build orientation significantly influenced weld quality and microstructure.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing was performed to validate the weld joint properties.
